description: Copies a report of type SlideDeck with its slides, datasheets and email setup, as Duplicate in the app does, and answers the copy, which you own. Its schedules and direct shares are copied only when asked. Only members who may duplicate the report may: view access is enough. Each call makes another copy.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

copySchedules.description: Also give the copy the report's schedules, so it updates on its own at the same times. Defaults to `false`.

folderId.description: The folder to put the copy in, by its `id` from `listFolders`; it must be one you can add reports to. If omitted, the copy goes in the report's own folder, or for a burst's variant, in the burst's folder.

inheritSharing.description: Also share the copy with everyone the report is shared with directly, at the same permission. Defaults to `false`, so only you can open it until you share it.

name.description: Name for the copy, as members will see it in Rollstack. Leading and trailing spaces are removed, and it can't be blank.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: duplicateReport
title: Duplicate report
